bagPolicy.summary: Clear bags up to 12 × 6 × 12 inches and small nonclear clutches up to 4.5 × 6.5 inches are allowed; all bags may be inspected. Large bags and backpacks are prohibited.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: Valet parking near the Exchange Street entrance is listed at $20, with additional paid lots a short walk away. The venue recommends arranging another way to travel if possible.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: The venue recommends rideshare because parking in the Stockyards is limited; its FAQ does not specify a dedicated pickup curb.
rideshare.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

concessions.summary: Five full-service bars sell drinks inside; the tavern serves food before shows. Outside food or drinks are prohibited.
concessions.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

accessibility.summary: Accessible tickets are sold online and there are limited seats for last-minute needs. For assisted listening, call at least two days ahead; for an interpreter, at least four weeks ahead.
accessibility.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

reEntry.summary: Guests who leave cannot return without a new ticket.
reEntry.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

ticketPickup.summary: Collect will-call tickets at the venue box office with photo ID matching the purchaser’s name. Tour and guest-list tickets usually arrive on the event day close to door time.
ticketPickup.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

gates.summary: Music Hall doors usually open about 60 minutes before showtime, though the individual event page controls. Metal detection or pat-down and bag inspection may occur at entry.
gates.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.
